name: live-city-3d
description: Every train in London, live, in 3D

scripts.setup: npm install && npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
